{{Quote|I guess Druckenwell's gone, too?''"<br />"''And Falleen. They've reached Rodia. It's the heavy end of the hammer, pounding and pounding.|[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]|<ref name="BP" />}}
A '''battle''' was fought during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] on [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]]. During their campaign to cut off the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], Druckenwell was among the conquered [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] including [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]], [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] and [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. While a certain percentage of the population was evacuated aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]], those left behind were tasked with dismantling Druckenwell's cities and using arable land to grow Yuuzhan Vong [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]].

==History==
===Invasion===
{{Quote|As you see, our hyperspace probes are returning limited information. Kalarba, Druckenwell, and Falleen are lost. Even if we could retain Rodia, the Corellian Run is cut.|[[Ayddar Nylykerka]]|<ref name="BP" />}}
[[File:Druckenwell_FF19.jpg|left|thumb|Druckenwell's crowded cities were divided by wide oceans, and almost all of the planet's available land was developed]]
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] race of invaders, the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], launched a massive [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conquest campaign]] directed against all worlds of the [[Galactic community]].<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref> [[26 ABY/Legends|Less than a year later]],<ref name="IYV">{{GamerCite|8|I, Yuuzhan Vong}}</ref> in an attempt to cut off the Rimward leg of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], a vital [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]],<ref name="BP" /> the Yuuzhan Vong initiated a blitz across the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]]<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and [[Battle of Kalarba|devastated]] [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]]. The isolated worlds along the Corellian Run toward the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] went on full alert as the Yuuzhan Vong captured them one after another.<ref name="BP" />

[[Druckenwell]] was an industrialized, overpopulated urban world – a symbol of everything the Yuuzhan Vong found abominable about the civilizations inhabiting their «promised» worlds. The massive corporations that had served as the true authority on the planet mounted no resistance, which was fortunate; faced with opposition, the [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet|invasion fleet]] might have cleansed the world of all life and technology. Instead, the population shifted its efforts from toiling for corporate profits to laboring for the greater glory of the Yuuzhan Vong. Their first two assignments were to prepare proper fields for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food production]]<ref name="NJOS" /> and other resources<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|I|211|Druckenwell}}</ref> and to dismantle the congested metropolises in which they had once lived.<ref name="NJOS" /> While the planets Druckenwell and [[Battle of Falleen (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Falleen]] were captured by the invaders, the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] was [[Battle of Rodia (Yuuzhan Vong War)|placed]] in a vulnerable position.<ref name="BP" />

===Aftermath===
{{Quote|There is no failure, only glorious success or a glorious death.|Commander [[Malik Carr]], to Yuuzhan Vong commandos|<ref name="Hive" />}}
[[File:Ka-Tu-Un.jpg|right|thumb|300px|Yuuzhan Vong commandos are trying to capture the «Jedi»]]
Prisoners captured in the battle for the planet Druckenwell revealed that there might have been a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] hiding aboard the converted [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Chilastra]]'', which was part of the [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] fleet attempting to leave the [[Druckenwell system/Legends|Druckenwell system]]. The Yuuzhan Vong were intensely curious about the Jedi, whom they regarded as a threat to their otherwise inevitable conquest. Previous attempts to capture or convert Jedi had failed, and this time the Yuuzhan Vong were determined not to miss a new opportunity. For this mission, Commander [[Malik Carr]] personally assembled a group of elite commandos and ordered them to capture the suspected Jedi. Using a captured [[New Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the commandos boarded the refugee freighter ''Chilastra'', which was hiding among the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] of the Druckenwell system. Once aboard – by any means necessary – they were to capture the possible Jedi known as [[Ka-Tu-Un]] and return him to the Yuuzhan Vong fleet in orbit over Druckenwell.<ref name="Hive" />
